title: Apple Vision Pro Impressions!
summary: Marques Brownlee shares his hands-on impressions of Apple's $3500 Vision Pro headset after trying it. He covers the spatial computing experience, eye tracking, and how it compares to other devices.
why: HN used it as an early, credible hands-on report showing the headset roughly matched Apple's demos.
